story.iWant: a support page with FAQs and contact links
story.soThat: I can get help when needed
story.tasks: - Create Support Page Component (AC: 1) - Implement FAQ Section (AC: 2) - Implement Troubleshooting Section (AC: 3) - Implement Contact Section (AC: 4) - Add Translations (AC: 5) - Route Integration (AC: 1)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. A navigation link "Support" in the Header leads to the Support page. 2. The page renders within the main AppLayout (Header + Sidebar + Main + Log). 3. A collapsible FAQ section (using Accordion) displays common questions. 4. A "Common Errors" section lists specific error messages (e.g., "Device not found", "VIP authentication failed") with solution steps. 5. Contact cards for "Telegram" and "Facebook" are displayed with icons and open in new tabs. 6. All UI text is available in both English and Vietnamese via i18n.

story-context.constraints: - Must follow the unified project structure (src/pages/ for page components). - Use shadcn/ui components for consistency (Accordion, Card). - No new stores needed for this static content. - Responsive design: Cards should stack on mobile/tablet. - All external links must use rel="noopener noreferrer" and target="_blank".

tests.standards: Verify that all external links open in new tabs. Check translation keys exist for both languages. Verify responsiveness of the layout on smaller screens.
